classification.analysis: This is Microsoft's official sample collection demonstrating the Python Microsoft Agent Framework, covering agent basics, tool calling, multi-turn sessions, persistent history (SQLite/Redis), long-term memory (Redis, Mem0), sub-agent context isolation, tool-approval gating, middleware, RAG knowledge retrieval (Azure AI Search, Postgres pgvector, SQLite FTS5), MCP server integration (local and remote), and multi-agent workflows (fan-out/fan-in, sequential orchestration, MagenticOne, streaming). It supports Microsoft Foundry (Azure OpenAI), OpenAI.com, and local Ollama models, and includes IaC (Bicep) for provisioning Azure resources plus a devcontainer/Codespaces setup. Aimed at Python developers learning or evaluating the Microsoft Agent Framework for building production-grade agentic applications.

use_cases.title: Learn Microsoft Agent Framework patterns like tool calling, memory, and RAG
Build a multi-agent workflow with fan-out/fan-in or sequential orchestration
Connect an agent to a local or remote MCP server for tool use
Provision Azure OpenAI models via Bicep IaC for agent experiments
